title: Zesty Algerian Pineapple Tagine
description: A fragrant, citrus‑laden tagine featuring sweet pineapple chunks, tender chickpeas, and aromatic spices that soothe hangovers and delight the palate.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium tagine or heavy‑bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add the cumin, coriander, smoked paprika and grated ginger, sautéing for 30 seconds until fragrant, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the pineapple chunks, orange zest, and chickpeas, stirring to coat with spices.
Pour in the lemon juice, add a pinch of salt, then reduce heat to low; cover and let simmer for 20 minutes, allowing flavors to meld and the pineapple to soften.
Remove the lid, increase heat to medium, and cook for an additional 5 minutes to thicken the sauce slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then remove from heat.
Transfer to serving dishes and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro before serving.
